Description: Columbus is a Golden Triangle city beside Columbus Air Force Base and the 14th Flying Training Wing's undergraduate pilot-training mission. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Mississippi's military-retirement tax exemption, Walmart access, affordable typical home values, and riverfront and historic-district amenities. Tradeoffs include moderate 2025 reported violent crime, hot humid summers, no local Costco, and only a county-level lean-conservative election baseline.
